name: Arvid Groth
source:
Feared as the monster who prowls the region transforming and enslaving all who oppose him into pliant vampire thralls, Arvid has waited centuries for the reappearance of the Coral Sea King. He has a contract with the sentient enchanted scythe he wields which bestowed the gift of undeath allowing him to survive beyond the years of his initial mortal frame.

Arvid gathers the rings in hopes of restoring the skeletal spirit which constantly hovers around him in complete silence.
translation:
Feared as the monster who prowls the region transforming and enslaving all who oppose him into pliant vampire thralls, Arvid has waited centuries for the reappearance of the Coral Sea King. He has a contract with the sentient enchanted scythe he wields which bestowed the gift of undeath allowing him to survive beyond the years of his initial mortal frame.

Arvid gathers the rings in hopes of restoring the skeletal spirit which constantly hovers around him in complete silence.
